package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for gorm_model_outside_models_package: GORM-backed structs with `gorm` tags declared outside `model` or `models` packages unless an explicit `entity` or `schema` package already exists.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func scenario065Positive(db *gorm.DB, tenantID int) ([]struct {
	ID       int    `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	TenantID int    `gorm:"index"`
	Name     string `gorm:"size:255"`
}, error) {
	type localRecord struct {
		ID       int    `gorm:"primaryKey"`
		TenantID int    `gorm:"index"`
		Name     string `gorm:"size:255"`
	}
	var items []localRecord
	if err := db.Where("tenant_id = ?", tenantID).Find(&items).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	result := make([]struct {
		ID       int    `gorm:"primaryKey"`
		TenantID int    `gorm:"index"`
		Name     string `gorm:"size:255"`
	}, len(items))
	for i, v := range items {
		result[i] = struct {
			ID       int    `gorm:"primaryKey"`
			TenantID int    `gorm:"index"`
			Name     string `gorm:"size:255"`
		}(v)
	}
	return result, nil
}
